name: spend
description: A research agent and a critic in a loop: each round costs 3 credits (research 2, critique 1), and a task goes round until the critic is satisfied. The file's budget is the most any one task may spend; the producer may lower it per task when it injects, never raise it.

neurons.description: This week's research tasks, one trace each.
Asks for another round until the task has had enough.
